name: Staked oracle pool (reputation-gated submit → trimmed-mean finalize → cross-fiber consumer read)
description: A reusable staked-epoch-pool (FORMING→COLLECTING→SETTLED→COLLECTING…→CLOSED) specialized as an oracle. Participants stake (custody Transfer into Fiber(poolId), re-verified via heldAssets — H5) and join under a reputation gate (signerHasReputationVia, the #24 dynamic-dependency pattern). They submit numeric datapoints appended to an array via merge; finalize computes an outlier-bounded TRIMMED MEAN over the array (drop single min + single max, EXACT-rational arithmetic, no truncation), publishes result.value + the in-consensus address set, and credits entitlement as the inConsensus ledger — emitting ZERO asset transfers. Rewards are pulled per-claim (claim_reward moves ONE whole reward instance to a verified, in-consensus, not-yet-claimed signer). A consumer reads the published value cross-fiber via an epoch-pinned depInState(SETTLED) gate. Composes existing SDK guards/effects only.

events.name: bind_registry
events.description: Authority binds the identity registry (#24) — must precede joins

events.name: finalize
events.description: Trimmed-mean aggregate + publish result + credit inConsensus (zero transfers)

events.name: claim_reward
events.description: In-consensus participant pulls one whole reward instance

events.name: reset_epoch
events.description: Authority advances the epoch; clears submissions

events.name: withdraw_stake
events.description: Participant reclaims their staked instance (one whole transfer)

testFlows.name: Worked oracle flow — join, submit, trimmed-mean finalize, claim, reset
testFlows.description: The end-to-end happy path. Bind the registry, open epoch 1, 4 participants stake+join (3 clustered values + 1 outlier), finalize after quorum computes the trimmed mean and excludes the outlier from inConsensus, an in-consensus participant claims a reward, then the authority resets the epoch.

testFlows.name: Rejected — finalize before quorum is denied
testFlows.description: With fewer than `quorum` (3) submissions, the finalize guard's count>=quorum clause is false → the transition is rejected and the fiber stays at COLLECTING.
